user.title: Victron ESS Control Setup
user.description:
Configure your Victron Energy ESS system.

Find your system serial in HA → Settings → Devices → search 'victron mqtt', or in VRM Portal → Installation → Device List → GX Device.

**Requirement:** [ha-victron-mqtt](https://github.com/tomer-w/ha-victron-mqtt) must be installed and configured.

data.grid_serial: Grid System Serial (GX device portal ID)
data.consumer_serial: Consumer System Serial (leave empty if same as grid)

data_description.grid_serial: Hexadecimal portal ID of the GX device connected to the grid meter, e.g. a1b2c3d4ef56
data_description.consumer_serial: Only needed for dual-system setups (separate GX device for 3-phase loads). Leave empty for single-system.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Total usable battery capacity in kWh
data_description.charge_efficiency: Round-trip charge efficiency. Use 0.95 for lithium, 0.85 for lead-acid.

error.victron_mqtt_missing: ha-victron-mqtt integration is not installed. Install it via HACS first: https://github.com/tomer-w/ha-victron-mqtt
error.victron_mqtt_not_configured: ha-victron-mqtt is installed but not configured. Add it via Settings → Integrations first.
error.invalid_serial: Serial must be a non-empty hexadecimal string (6–16 characters).
error.packages_not_enabled: HA packages are not enabled. Add 'packages: !include_dir_named packages' under 'homeassistant:' in configuration.yaml, then restart HA before running setup.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the HA logs.

abort.already_configured: Victron ESS Control is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of Victron ESS Control is allowed.

data.consumer_serial: Consumer System Serial (empty = same as grid)
